text: 2b.3 TAMAM — Faz 2b kapandi. 68 etiketi netlesti: 62 donor-ozel dosya / 29 cpp modulu, 6 kanit hattiyla (vcxproj/sinif/canli-map+obj/PDB/exe-string/config+log) siniflandirildi: 7 canlida VAR-parite tamam (AUTOHP, PC_AddBuff, CustomJewelBank, SkillDamage = 2b.0'dan; B_MocNap, BotTrade, SkillDamageConfig = bizde paralel), 3 is-kalemi 2c'ye (YENI KESIF: EventGvG — canli ServerInfo 7 config anahtari kanitli ama bizde yok; AntiSkillDelay = canli SkillManager icinde bizde VAR; ThuongDanhBoss = canlida sifir iz), 19 canlida YOK -> OFF/tasinmaz (APIGameGuard, CGMHardwareId, CGMEarring/FlagNat/Pet, CMixGoblinExpansion, CharacterAdvance, ChatManager, ConsoleDebug, CustomExchangeCoin, EventFindPath, GMHolyItem, LogToFile, MasterResetTable, MultiLanguage, MyTimer, SendMessage, WindowsConsole, BlackList-donor). Kritik netlesme: canli BlackList.txt IpManager'a ait (bizde VAR), donor CBlackList degil. Rapor: docs/12, ham veri: BuildLog/envanter/muig68_*. Siradaki: 2c.1 (60 modul oncelik dizimi).
